v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.en: Make a joyful noise * before the Lord our King.
Lord, * thou hast been our refuge. ‡
O Lord, * thy mercy is in heaven.

text.la: Pópulus meus, * ait Dóminus, bonis meis adimplébitur.
text.en: My people, * said the Lord, shall be filled with good things.
To our God * be joyful and fitting praise.

text.la: Nox præcéssit, dies autem appropinquávit. Abiciámus ergo ópera tenebrárum, et induámur arma lucis. Sicut in die honéste ambulémus.
text.en: The night is passed, and the day is at hand. Let us therefore cast off the works of darkness, and put on the armour of light. Let us walk honestly, as in the day.

v.en: We are filled in the morning with thy mercy.

r.en: And we have rejoiced, and are delighted.

text.la: In sanctitáte * serviámus Dómino, et liberábit nos ab inimícis nostris.
text.en: In holiness * let us serve the Lord, and he will deliver us from our enemies.

text.la: Deus, refúgium nostrum et virtus: adésto piis Ecclésiæ tuæ précibus, auctor ipse pietátis, et præsta; ut, quod fidéliter pétimus, efficáciter consequámur.
text.en: O God, our Refuge and Strength, Who art the author of all godliness, be ready, we beseech thee, to hear the devout prayers of thy Church, and grant that those things which we ask faithfully, we may obtain effectually.

text.la: Euge, serve bone et fidélis, quia in pauca fuísti fidélis, supra multa te constítuam, intra in gáudium Dómini tui.
text.en: Well done, thou good and faithful servant; thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things; enter thou into the joy of thy Lord.

v.la: Iustum dedúxit Dóminus per vias rectas.
v.en: The Lord guided the just in right paths.

r.en: And showed him the kingdom of God.

text.la: Intercéssio nos, quǽsumus, Dómine, beáti Hilariónis Abbátis comméndet: ut, quod nostris méritis non valémus, eius patrocínio assequámur.
text.en: May the pleading of blessed Hilarion, the Abbot, make us acceptable unto thee, O Lord, we pray; that what we may not have through any merits of ours, we may gain by means of his patronage.

title.la: Ss. Ursulæ et Sociarum Virg. et Mart.
title.en: Ss. Ursula and Companions, Virg. and Mart.

text.la: Prudéntes vírgines, aptáte vestras lámpades: ecce sponsus venit, exíte óbviam ei.
text.en: Trim your lamps, O ye wise virgins: Behold the Bridegroom cometh; go ye out to meet Him.

v.en: After her shall virgins be brought unto the King.

r.en: Her fellows shall be brought unto thee.

text.la: Da nobis, quǽsumus, Dómine Deus noster, sanctárum Vírginum et Mártyrum tuárum Ursulæ et Sociárum palmas incessábili devotióne venerári: ut quas digna mente non póssumus celebráre, humílibus saltem frequentémus obséquiis.
text.en: Grant unto us, we beseech thee, O Lord, our God, that we may ever call to mind, with all worship and thanksgiving, the victory of thy holy Virgins and Martyrs Ursula and her companions, and although we know that our mind cannot comprehend thee who art this day their exceeding great reward, give us always the grace humbly to worship thee.

office.title: Feria Quinta infra Hebd XXII post Octavam Pentecostes III. Octobris
